-- Find Interior Paint products
SELECT DISTINCT sku, product_name, category, subcategory, is_current
FROM dim_product
WHERE (product_name ILIKE '%Interior Paint%' OR product_name ILIKE '%Paint%' OR subcategory ILIKE '%Paint%')
  AND is_current
LIMIT 20

calls.statement:
-- Units of Interior Paint sold in Lahti store in P3 FY26/27
SELECT 
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id = 108  -- Lahti store
  AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13
